Part D   Evidence
1.   I am the Respondent in these proceedings.
2.   I agree with the background facts regarding our marriage and child.
RESPONSE TO ALLEGATIONS OF CONTROLLING BEHAVIOUR (AUGUST   –
OCTOBER 2025)
3.   Throughout 2024 and 2025 relationship with Jill have been strained despite my best efforts to
get them back on track.
4.   Jill has gone to incredible lengths to insult me, for example, on 10 October 2024 Jill sent me
an email with the subject ‘test’, presumably to make me read it.
5.   The contents of the subject simply read “Go fuck yourself Joe”
6.   When discussing custody from April to June 2024, Jill’s behaviour was even worse,
including on May 1 2024 where she explicitly threatened me “ I'll make sure you regret it.” If I
didn’t do what she said.
Signature of person making this affidavit (deponent)   Signature of witness
7.   The vitriol is almost never ending:
a)   On May 5   2024 she send me an email calling me a “ worthless excuse for a parent ”.
b)   On May 29 2024 she blackmailed me with the threat of withdrawing child support if I
did not comply with her requests.
c)   On June 20 2024 she called me a fat loser.
d)   I have more examples I can show the court of this behaviour.
8.   On May 25 she withheld Johnny from his regular weekend visitation for no reason at all.
9.   Most concerningly, on June 12 2024 explicitly stated she would start telling people that I
abused Johnny if I did not do what she wanted me to do. Her false domestic violence claims
are an extension of this blackmail.
EVENTS OF 1 NOVEMBER 2025
10.   On or about 4 November 2025 , Jill’s behaviour was erratic and possessive.
11.   She made a comment about "girls staring at me" and needing to "fight them off." While she
laughed, her tone was menacing.
12.   She then financially shamed me, stating, "I don't give you cash so you can spend it on other
people." Jill controls all our finances. I have to ask her for money for basic social
interactions.
13.   When I received a call from an old school friend, Jill exploded. She screamed obscenities.
14.   I retreated to the bedroom for safety. Jill did not "knock." She hammered on the door with
such force I thought the hinges would break. She was screaming, "Open the [expletive]
door!" She was out of control.
RESPONSE TO ALLEGATIONS OF 3 NOVEMBER 2025
15.   I vehemently deny the assault allegations.
16.   The conversation alleged by Jill to have taken place on November 3, actually took place on
the 1 st   of November. I confronted Jill about her infidelity. I had reliable information that she
had been fixated on a neighbour, "Martin," who is outfitting a sailboat.
17.   I asked her about it calmly. She lied to my face, saying she didn't know him.
18.   I became emotional. I asked, "Does it give you that much pleasure to humiliate me?"
19.   Jill began to hyperventilate and sob hysterically. She was working herself into a panic to
avoid answering my questions.
20.   I deny striking her with a closed fist. Any movement of my hands seen on video was me
gesturing in frustration.
21.   I deny choking her. Jill looked as though she was going to faint. When Jill began
hyperventilating and stumbling I reached out my hands to steady her. My intention was to
prevent her from falling.
Signature of person making this affidavit (deponent)   Signature of witness
22.   Regarding the comment about the bread: I had spent the afternoon baking fresh bread for our
dinner, trying to do something nice for the family despite our troubles.
23.   When I said, "You'll pout and spoil our supper... Just smell the bread," I was trying to ground
her. I was trying to de-escalate her hysteria and remind her that we had a family meal
prepared.
24.   Jill has manipulated this context to make a moment of domestic effort look like
psychological abuse.
25.   Jill’s allegations of violence is an attempt to distract from her own threatening behaviour
towards me during this period.
CONCLUSION
26.   Jill is attempting to alienate me from Johnny to cover up her own emotional instability and
infidelity.
27.   I seek equal shared parental responsibility.
